caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic instrument with a long, thin handle that terminates in a circular ring at one end and a shaped, irregular triangular loop at the other. The metal is colored with shades of brown, gray, and blue to indicate texture and dimensionality. Below the instrument, there is an outline drawing of the triangular loop in a reddish-brown color, positioned centrally beneath the main object. The background is plain and cream-colored, with the artist's name, Elizabeth Johnson, printed in small text in the lower left corner. The drawing is bordered by a thin, rectangular line close to the paper’s edge.
title: Branding Iron
